output.title: Changing your billing email address
output.content: To change the email address that receives invoices, go to Account Settings > Billing > Billing Contact and update the email field. This does not change your login email.

output.title: Account locked — too many failed login attempts
output.content: If your account is locked after several incorrect password attempts, wait 30 minutes and try again, or use the 'Forgot password' link on the login page to reset your password immediately via an emailed link. This is fully self-service — no need to contact support.

output.title: Account locked — suspicious activity flag
output.content: If your account was locked due to a suspicious-activity flag (unusual location, new device, or an admin-triggered security hold), it cannot be unlocked by resetting your password. You must contact support directly so an agent can verify your identity manually before restoring access.
